history.p: On 1 January 1870 Hartmann wrote to Hans Christian Andersen: "Jeg vil gjøre Dig et Forslag: Du sender mig et nyt Digt, jeg sender Dig et componeret tilbage; saa ere alle Parter hjulpne: jeg har faaet Brev, Du har faaet Svar derpaa. Verden har faaet nyt Digt af Dig, og den kan jo saa spille eller synge min Musik, hvis den gider." (I'll make you a suggestion: you send me a new poem and I'll return it with music. Thus all parties involved will have been helped: I've received a letter, you've got a reponse. The world have received a new poem by you, and it may of course then play or sing my music, if it cares to do so.). On 20 February Andersen wrote the poem "Aldrig er Ungdomstiden forbi", being the third stanza of the text to "Foraarssang", and posted it to Hartmann six days later. Hartmann was not that quick as he did not end-date his score until 6 February 1871.

annot.p: Wüerst thinks erroneously that the work is composed by J.P.E. Hartmann's son Emil Hartmann who at that time was a well known composer in Germany. The mistake is corrected in NBM vol. 32 no. 205.
The author confuses J.P.E. Hartmann with his son Emil Hartmann.
